comment: Written against xAI's Grok Build 1.0.46 (native binary from x.ai/cli/install.sh; full-screen TUI on the alternate screen) from live sessions recorded in a pty against an OpenAI-compatible LM Studio endpoint (GROK_MODELS_BASE_URL, XAI_API_KEY and a [model.*] base_url in a throwaway ~/.grok/config.toml, no xAI login); must be re-verified when Grok Build changes its TUI. Grok redraws the whole screen and removes an answered dialog, so the approval rule may look at the whole screen. A tool permission dialog (options like '1 (●) Yes, and don't ask again for anything (always-approve mode)' … '3 (○) Yes, proceed', '4 (○) No, reject (type to add feedback)', footer '1/5:select  │  Tab:next option  │ …'; with the focus moved off it by Esc the footer reads 'Tab/Space:permission  │ …') is BLOCKED. The spinner line ending in '[stop]' ('⠙ Waiting for response… 0.1s … [stop]', 'Writing command…') and the footer 'Shift+Tab:mode  │  Ctrl+c:cancel' are WORKING; the input box ('│ ❯ ' above '─ <model> ─╯') without them is IDLE. The default option of the dialog is always-approve, so Enter alone approves everything: reject with ↓ ↓ ↓ Enter (option 4). Superagent's grok-cli is a different program with its own rule file (grok.json).
